rulings.item: 1120C start-up regression (#7046) bisected to COMPAT19-TUNABLE efe95309f (+2,532 empty main / +6,423 three libs / +2,595 clock_gettime; LD-SPLIT-3 and later merges add nothing); the cost is in ld.so (~1.3k per object searched + ~1.2k fixed), not the flag read this story removes, and is not removed here
rulings.recommendation: a follow-up story: per-function split of ld.so's start (gdb single-step of the bisect products), first test the candidate that each start dependency is fully checked twice (dlopen::check in image::open_candidate and map::load's plan), measuring origin/next first

rulings.item: Brief step 1 (apply in the loader's PT_GNU_STACK branch) is impossible at start: that branch runs before libc is mapped and relocated, so libc's thread flag cannot be set there; the check sits inside the existing GLIBC_TUNABLES-is-set closure instead (no cost on a start without the tunable, count-verified)
